sense.sense_net: VRAW to IN+ through R_SENSE_TOP; IN+ to GND through R_SENSE_BOTTOM; REF VOUT to IN-
sense.fault_path: TLV3601 OUT goes high on OVP; base resistor to Q_OVP; Q_OVP collector pulls CLR_n low
sense.limits: divider exact MPN/TCR and clamp back-power are OPEN; comparator outside common-mode is not functional proof

logic_and_pg.PG_wired_AND: Both TPS7A16-Q1 open-drain PG pins join PG_OK; 10k pull-up to 5V. PG_OK drives CLR_n pull-up release and the Q_INP_RELEASE base resistor.
logic_and_pg.CLR_n: 10k pull-up to 5V; PG outputs sink low when either rail is not good; Q_OVP NPN collector also sinks low. CLR dominates CLK/ARM.
logic_and_pg.PRE_n: pin 7 independently pulled to 5V; never connected to CLR_n; both-low is prohibited while latch VCC is in range.
logic_and_pg.ARM: B3U-1000P switch from 5V to CLK pin 1; 100k CLK-to-GND pull-down; D pin 2 tied to 5V. Contact bounce cannot clear a fault; fault CLR remains dominant.
logic_and_pg.feedback: Q pin 5 drives LTC7001 INP through 1k; Qbar pin 3 NC; latch VCC pin 8 from 5V; GND pin 4 to GND.
logic_and_pg.rail_policy: Both LDOs are powered from protected battery VIN, outside the buck output fault path. Rail sequencing and PG behavior below LDO VIN validity remain OPEN.

driver_and_disconnect.VCCUV: pin 2 to GND: minimum rising UVLO selection (datasheet 3.1-3.7V rising, 2.8-3.4V falling table limits; exact switching point is not used as a timing guarantee)
driver_and_disconnect.OVLO: pin 5 to GND; divider-to-OVLO is not used because threshold tolerance has not been closed against the 11.1605V normal-bus limit
driver_and_disconnect.C_BOOT: 0.1uF minimum between BST pin 9 and TS pin 8
driver_and_disconnect.topology: Q1 drain to VRAW; Q2 drain to VSAFE/eFuse IN; both sources tied at TS; both gates tied to TGDN pin 6; TGUP pin 7 reaches each gate through its own 10ohm turn-on resistor; each gate has a separate 10k gate-to-its-own-source bleed.

fail_low_clamp.Q_INP_CLAMP: MMBT3904LT1G, collector to INP, emitter to GND, base fed from 12V_DRIVER through 22k
fail_low_clamp.Q_INP_RELEASE: MMBT3904LT1G, collector to Q_INP_CLAMP base, emitter to GND, base from PG_OK through 82k; valid PG_OK turns clamp transistor off; bad/missing PG releases its base and clamps INP low
fail_low_clamp.status: candidate-only bias sizing; beta corners, clamp VIL margin and transistor pin-level macromodel not simulated
